topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Well, Sir, it seems there's a bit of trouble in the village school. Young Tom, he's been caught with someone else's words in his head, or so they say. I always taught my own that what you sow, you reap. But the crops don’t always show what was planted, do they? Some days, you look at a harvest and wonder how it came to be. I reckon the lad just wanted a good showing, like a field of golden wheat on a fine summer’s day. But we all know, the true worth of a crop is in the toil and sweat put into the earth, not in what’s borrowed from another’s plot. Hope the old schoolmaster shows him the error without too much of the rod. We need good hearts in the village, not just full minds.
